title: TDA-MIT: Mouse Skin and Lung Tissue Selection and Collection
author: Ke Zhang

steps.title: Select Mouse Cohorts
steps.instruction: Select clinically healthy p16-3MR mice (RRID: IMSR_JAX:037045) from The Jackson Laboratory from two age groups: young (2–3 months) and old (24–26 months).

steps.title: Dissect Skin and Lung Tissues
steps.instruction: Following euthanasia according to institutional animal care guidelines, dissect tissues under sterile and controlled conditions.

substeps.instruction: Excise full-thickness dorsal trunk skin from a consistent anatomical region.
Open the thoracic cavity and remove the lungs.
Dissect peripheral tissue from the lower lobes of the lungs, avoiding major airways.

steps.title: Embed and Store Tissues
steps.instruction: Immediately after dissection, embed tissues in OCT compound and snap-freeze without additional treatment.

substeps.instruction: Store embedded tissues at –80 °C until further processing.

steps.title: Prepare Tissue Sections
steps.instruction: Cryosection the frozen OCT-embedded tissue blocks for downstream analysis.

substeps.instruction: Use tissue sections for spatial sequencing with Raman imaging.
Process adjacent sections or frozen tissue fragments for nuclei isolation for snRNA-seq.
